# vscode-jupyter-cell-tags Codebase Summary

## 1. Overall Project Structure

This is a **feature-modular VS Code extension** (TypeScript → `out/`, entry `src/extension.ts`). It extends Microsoft's Jupyter Cell Tags fork with run groups, tree views, execution tracking, git diff, and more.

```
C:\Users\pho\repos\VSCode Extensions\vscode-jupyter-cell-tags\
├── package.json          # Manifest: commands, views, menus, settings, activation
├── src/
│   ├── extension.ts      # Main orchestrator — activates all modules
│   ├── helper.ts         # Core tag read/write + conflict detection
│   ├── json.ts           # JSON AST for editTagsInJSON
│   ├── statusBar.ts      # Selected-cells status bar
│   ├── cellTags/         # Core tagging (status bar provider, add/remove commands)
│   ├── noteAllTags/      # "All Notebook Tags" tree view + scrollbar decorators
│   ├── notebookRunGroups/# Tag-based cell execution ("run groups")
│   ├── tagProperties/    # Tag metadata (color, priority) in notebook metadata
│   ├── models/           # TagProperties interface
│   ├── cellHeadings/     # Markdown heading depth/select/delete
│   ├── cellJumpbacks/    # Bookmark navigation
│   ├── cellExecution/    # Execution history + Executed Cells view
│   ├── cellHistory/      # Cell history tracking
│   ├── cellNavigation/   # Navigation quick-pick menu
│   ├── cellMetadataDisplay/ # Webview panel for cell metadata
│   ├── customOutline/    # Custom notebook outline tree
│   ├── outlineSync/      # Sync outline with programmatic selections
│   ├── exportTags/       # Export tags to JSON
│   ├── importTags/       # Import tags from JSON
│   ├── exportExecutedCode/
│   ├── gitDiff/          # Git diff highlighting + Modified Cells view
│   ├── jupyterEnhancements/ # Execution hijacks, decorations, scratchpad
│   ├── ringMeJupyter/    # Email notifications on cell finish
│   └── util/             # logging, notebookMetadata, notebookSelection, cellVisualHighlight
├── examples/             # Test notebooks + manual testing guide
└── .kiro/steering/       # Internal architecture docs
```

**Activation pattern:** Each module exposes `register()` or `activate*()` called from `extension.ts`. Context keys (`jupyter-cell-tags.*`) are set in `extension.ts` on editor/selection changes.

**Dependencies:** `ms-toolsai.jupyter` (required), `@vscode/jupyter-extension` (kernel API).

---

## 2. Cell Tags Implementation

### Storage (reading/writing)

Tags live in standard Jupyter cell metadata:

```26:55:C:\Users\pho\repos\VSCode Extensions\vscode-jupyter-cell-tags\src\helper.ts
export function getCellTags(cell: vscode.NotebookCell): string[] {
    const currentTags = (useCustomMetadata() ? cell.metadata.custom?.metadata?.tags : cell.metadata.metadata?.tags) ?? [];
    return [...currentTags];
}

export async function updateCellTags(cell: vscode.NotebookCell, tags: string[], defer_apply: boolean = false) {
    const metadata = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cell.metadata));
    if (useCustomMetadata()) {
        metadata.custom = metadata.custom || {};
        metadata.custom.metadata = metadata.custom.metadata || {};
        metadata.custom.metadata.tags = tags;
        // ...
    }
    // Applies via WorkspaceEdit + NotebookEdit.updateCellMetadata
}
```

- **Path:** `cell.metadata.custom.metadata.tags` (or `metadata.metadata.tags` when VS Code drops custom metadata)
- **`useCustomMetadata()`** in `src/util/notebookMetadata.ts` checks `vscode.ipynb` extension exports
- Metadata is sorted alphabetically via `sortObjectPropertiesRecursively()` to minimize git noise

### Core tag API (`src/cellTags/cellTags.ts`)

| Function/Class | Role |
|---|---|
| `addCellTag()` | Merge new tags into existing, call `updateCellTags` |
| `addTagsToMultipleCells()` | Batch add |
| `CellTagStatusBarProvider` | Per-cell status bar UI |
| Commands | `addTag`, `addTagsToSelectedCells`, `removeTag`, `editTagsInJSON`, `paramaterize` |

### UI surfaces for tags

1. **Cell status bar** (`CellTagStatusBarProvider`) — registered for `jupyter-notebook`:
   - Each tag shows as `$(close) tagname` (click removes)
   - Optional color emoji from `TagPropertiesManager`
   - `$(plus) Tag` button to add

2. **Notebook cell title menu** (`notebook/cell/title` in package.json) — Add Tag, Edit JSON, Execute Run Group, heading commands

3. **Notebook cell context menu** (`notebook/cell/context`)

4. **"All Notebook Tags" tree view** (`all-notebook-tags-view`) — `src/noteAllTags/allNotebookTagsTreeDataProvider.ts`:
   - Tag → cells hierarchy
   - Sort by alphabetical / priority / dates
   - Rename, set color/priority, remove from all cells
   - Run tag, select cells, navigate with highlight

5. **"Cell Tags" view** (`cell-tag` in `jupyter-variables` container) — contributed in package.json but **no TreeDataProvider registered in this repo**; relies on Jupyter extension context (`jupyter:showTagsExplorer`). This extension contributes view/title menu items for it.

6. **Scrollbar decorators** (`src/noteAllTags/scrollbarDecorators.ts`) — colored markers for tagged cells

### Tag properties (notebook-level metadata)

`TagPropertiesManager` stores per-tag `priority`, `color`, `description` in `notebook.metadata.tagProperties`.

### Import/export

- `src/exportTags/exportTags.ts` — exports `{ index, tags }[]` to JSON
- `src/importTags/importTags.ts` — applies tags by cell index

### Special tag: `parameters`

`jupyter-cell-tags.paramaterize` adds the `parameters` tag (Papermill convention) — no other special handling found.

## 3. Cell Hiding/Showing Functionality

**There is no tag-based cell hiding/showing implementation** (no `remove-cell`, `hide-cell`, or nbconvert-style filtering).

What exists instead:

| Feature | What it does | File |
|---|---|---|
| **Hide cell toolbar** | Sets global `notebook.cellToolbarLocation` to `{ "default": "hidden" }` | `src/jupyterEnhancements/extension.ts` |
| **Custom outline filter** | Filters outline tree items by search text (not notebook cells) | `src/customOutline/startup.ts` |
| **View visibility deferral** | Defers outline updates while tree view is hidden | `src/customOutline/UpdateCoordinator.ts` |
| **Cell visual highlight** | Temporary decoration on navigate | `src/util/cellVisualHighlight.ts` |
| **Git diff highlights** | Border/background on changed cells | `src/gitDiff/gitDiffProvider.ts` |
| **Execution decorations** | Success/error backgrounds, flash, borders | `src/jupyterEnhancements/extension.ts` |
| **Cell metadata webview** | Toggle panel showing JSON metadata | `src/cellMetadataDisplay/cellMetadataDisplay.ts` |

README pending features mention "factor-out cells with a given set of tags" — **not implemented**.

### `remove-cell` tag references

**Zero matches** anywhere in the codebase (source, plans, examples). The closest related tags/commands:
- `jupyter-cell-tags.removeTag` — removes a tag from one cell
- `jupyter-cell-tags.removeTagFromAllCells` — removes a tag from all cells in notebook
- `jupyter-cell-tags.customOutline.deleteCellsUnderHeading` — deletes cells under a heading

## Relevant Code Patterns

### Tag-based execution (run groups)

```121:156:C:\Users\pho\repos\VSCode Extensions\vscode-jupyter-cell-tags\src\notebookRunGroups\util\cellActionHelpers.ts
export function executeGroup(targetRunTag: string, notebookCell?: vscode.NotebookCell) {
    const targetCells = doc?.getCells()
        .filter((notebookCell) => cellInGroup(notebookCell, targetRunTag))
        .map((cell) => ({ start: cell.index, end: cell.index + 1 }));
    vscode.commands.executeCommand('notebook.cell.execute', { ranges: targetCells });
}

function cellInGroup(cell: vscode.NotebookCell, targetCellTag: string) {
    return getCellTags(cell).includes(targetCellTag);
}
```

Run groups are **tag-name-based** (any tag string), not the legacy `notebookRunGroups.groupValue` metadata (that path exists in `cellMetadataHelpers.ts` but execution uses tags).

### Navigate to cell from tree

Pattern: set `NotebookRange` selection → `revealRange` → `highlightCell()` — used in All Tags, Executed Cells, Git Modified Cells views.

### Metadata edit via JSON

`editTagsInJSON` uses `json.parseTree` + `findNodeAtLocation` to open the raw `.ipynb` and select the `tags` node.

---

## Implications for `remove-cell` / Cell Hiding Feature

To add nbconvert-style `remove-cell` tag behavior, you would be building **new functionality**. The extension already has the building blocks:

- **Read tags:** `getCellTags()` in `helper.ts`
- **Write tags:** `updateCellTags()`, `addCellTag()`, `removeTag` command
- **UI patterns:** status bar provider, tree views, context menus, toolbar contributions
- **Visual feedback:** `cellVisualHighlight`, git diff decorations, jupyterEnhancements decorations
- **No existing filter/hide layer** on the notebook document itself — VS Code does not natively hide cells by tag, so implementation would likely need decorations + folding, a custom renderer, or document transformation on export/preview

If you want, I can next sketch an implementation plan for `remove-cell` tag support based on this architecture.
